title: Small Batch Raku Firing Workshop (June 20)
source_quote:
Small Batch Raku Firing Workshop

Instructor-Tricia Woodland from Clay King

Saturday, June 20, 2026
10:00 AM – 2:00 PM

$95, 6 participants Max.
evidence_sentence: Participants bring up to 6 bisqued pieces, paint raku glazes, and experience hands-on raku firing outdoors.
evidence_quote: Want to experience the thrill of fire dancing over your pottery to create the beauty and surprise of a raku firing?
summary: Raku firing workshop led by Tricia Woodland. Bring up to 6 bisqued pieces, paint on raku glazes (provided), and participate in outdoor raku firing. Max 6 participants.
